book.name: 2 JOHN
book.title: Id ash d John Oꞌohana am Haꞌi ha Wui mo e Wehm e Mihshmad

content: Ni-tatchui ni-wepnag: Am ant wo haꞌichu i em-oꞌohani ahni mani d hema ha wanimeddam wehsijj hegam mo ab si ihm g Jesus Christ. Si ani pihk ni-elid em-hekaj nach pi d t-wehm wohochuddam. Wehs g t-wehm wohochuddam o hab waꞌap si pihk e elid em-hekaj. Pi at hekid gam hu hab wo i e juh g wohokam ab t-amjed.
Ab o wa si s-em-hoꞌigeꞌid g t-ohg Jiosh g e-alidag Jesus Christ wehm ch ab wo wa baꞌich i em-mah g i wehmtadag ch s-ap tahhadkam. Kumt ab wo uꞌukchid g wohokam ch wo si pihk e elidad wehs ha hekaj.
Matt am oidch hab wo t-junihid g Jiosh chehanig
Si ani s-ap ni-tahtk ch ia haꞌi ha neid g em-wehm kihkam. K idam an uꞌukch g wohokam hab masma mo ab t-chehani g Jiosh.
Kuni ab wehs i em-gewkemhun mamt ab aꞌai e wui wo si pihk e elidad. Pi o d wechij chehanig ihda mani am em-ahgid. Edgid ach ihda ged hu i shohshon k amjed.
Kutt ab aꞌai t-wui wo si pihk t-elidad ch hekaj am wo t-chehgidad mach ab s-wohog elid ihda chehanigaj g Jiosh.
Muꞌi at an i wuwha mo chum s-ha mashchamamk g hemajkam ch eda d wabsh s-chu iꞌattomkam ch d obgaj g Jiosh alidag no pi pi ha mashcham mat ia mahsi k d oꞌodham hab masma mach ahchim.
Kumt heg hekaj wo s-e nenꞌoidk mamt pi gam hu hab wo i e juh ab amjed g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga k wabshaba wehs wo bei mo haschu ab em-makiog g Jiosh.
Hegam matp hedai am gawul wo juh g Jiosh alidag mashchama o pi shaꞌi mahch g Jiosh. S-mahch ach g Jiosh ch ep s-mahch g alidaj ahchim mach am oidch hab masma g alidaj mashchama.

Kumt heg hekaj pi ab hu wo ha kaihamad hegai mat hedai wo chum s-em-mashchamam k eda pi wo ahgachugad g Jiosh alidag mashchama. Pi g am hu wo i ha wahpkid e-kihki ed k chum hems pi hab wo chei ab ha wui. “Jiosh at wo wa em-wehmajk,”
mamt pi ab hu wo i ha wehmt hegam mat am wo ahgachugad g pi wohokam.
Mash s-ha neidamk g John ch ha wehm s-neokimk
Muꞌi ani haꞌichu s-em-ahgidamk ch wabshaba pi id hekaj am i em-oꞌohani nani pi am s-himimk mant wo em-neid k wo em-wehm neo. Kutt am t-wehm si s-ap wo t-tahtkk.
Ia o haꞌi kih g t-wepnag ch ash si pihk e elid em-hekaj.
